title: Spectrum 227kg-Capacity Steel Tipping Trailer | SP22124
description: Built to meet all your yard and garden haulage requirements, the Spectrum SP22124 Tipping Trailer is equipped with a hardwearing, power-coated stee l bed with an impressive load-capacity of 227kg (500lbs). It's manufactured to last, with its all-steel construction, rugged build-quality and large-diameter axle all working to ensure you'll get years of service from your purchase. Thanks to its high-sided design and wide, stable stance, the Spectrum SP22124 is great for carrying bulky items (logs, fence posts, strimmers, etc.). Large-diameter pneumatic tyres with a grip-tread provide traction and enhance manoeuvrability on rough ground; the incorporation of grease nipples on the wheel bearings makes it easy to keep things running smoothly. Also featured on the Spectrum SP22124 is a removable tailgate, which makes for easy loading and deposition. The universal hitch pin that comes with this model makes it compatible with all brands of ATV and garden tractor.
feature_1: A towed garden cart ideal for shifting logs, tools, bales, animal feed and more around your property
feature_2: Large-capacity dumper body means fewer trips back and forth
feature_4: Wide pneumatic tyres for excellent manoeuvrability and traction
feature_5: Built to last, with a steel bed, strengthened axle and bearing-mounted wheels
includes_1364: Trailer with universal hitchpin and removable tailgate
